gb_param_law: General parameters used for BLUE assimilation applied to hydraulic Laws.
cc_law_act: Enable or disable assimilation for the selected Law.
label_law_fld: Select the observation variable used for assimilation: H (water level) or Q (discharge).
rb_cote: Use water level (H) observations for the assimilation process.
rb_debit: Use discharge (Q) observations for the assimilation process.
rb_debit_lin: Use linearised discharge observations for the assimilation process.
label_law_seuil: Misfit rejection threshold: observations with a misfit above this value are excluded from BLUE assimilation.
label_law_sigma: Sigma iteration factor: controls the amplitude of corrections applied at each iteration.
label_pert_a: Initial perturbation applied to coefficient A.
label_pert_b: Initial perturbation applied to coefficient B.
lbl_typ_law: Select the Law to be configured.
bt_reload_laws: Reload the hydraulic Laws and associated control law.
bt_edit_law: Toggle editing mode for Law parameters and observation selection.
label_law_obs: Observation settings: standard deviations and physical bounds (minimum/maximum).
label_law_min: Minimum allowed value for coefficients A and B.
label_law_max: Maximum allowed value for coefficients A and B
gb_a_ctrl: Assimilation control parameters for coefficient A.
label_a_std: Standard deviation applied to corrections of coefficient A.
gb_b_ctrl: Assimilation control parameters for coefficient B.
label_b_std: Standard deviation applied to corrections of coefficient B.
bt_cancel_law: Cancel changes and close the window.
bt_zoom_law: Zoom to the spatial extent of the Law on the map.
bt_disp_law: Display the geometric object associated with the Law on the map.
bt_valid_law: Validate the changes and close the window.
